pages.text: The hookah accepts three fuel types with very different burn reserves:$(br2)$(2)Bamboo Charcoal:$() 25,000 active ticks$(br)$(item)Charcoal:$() 12,500 active ticks$(br)$(bad)Coal:$() 2,500 active ticks$(br2)Fuel time only counts down while the hookah can actively process shisha and water.
Make $(thing)Bamboo Charcoal$() by smelting or blasting Bamboo. It is the intended long-burning hookah fuel and lasts ten times as long as Coal in the hookah.
pages.title: Bamboo Charcoal

pages.text: One fresh Shisha Tobacco item has $(item)6,500 processing durability$(), equal to about $(item)5 minutes 25 seconds$() of continuous active use. This is 30% longer than the previous duration. The shisha is consumed when that timer is exhausted.
pages.title: Shisha Duration

pages.text: If the hookah will not light, verify all three contents: valid fuel, Shisha Tobacco, and a Water Potion. Also remember that an already-started fuel reserve can remain stored while the hookah is missing shisha or water.
pages.title: Troubleshooting
